regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the top-ranked theme with full breadth and high durability, but leadership is not a one-narrative market; crowding is elevated for banks and energy infrastructure. The absolute-trend gate, the only validated edge for drawdown control, keeps many themes eligible, though momentum rank itself has no forward alpha. No confirmed rotation handoff is present.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the leadership focus, eligible under the absolute-trend gate which provides drawdown-risk control historically. High durability and full breadth suggest trend persistence, but a crowded posture introduces mean-reversion risk. Overweight is a risk-controlled exposure, not a momentum bet.
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated as risk control
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.2 and mixed Hurst indicate potential mean reversion; the trend gate offers no return edge, only volatility and drawdown reduction.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar drops below 0.5 or breadth falls below 0.8, trend health would weaken, invalidating the risk-control lean.

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines show trending Hurst and the highest durability among eligible themes, supporting a risk-controlled overweight via the absolute-trend gate. Lack of ETF proxy means the call is unscorable, so conviction is low.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.78 is high, increasing concentration risk; unverifiable via a listed proxy makes the thesis harder to track.

falsifier.text: If Hurst flips to mean-revert or durability falls below 0.6, the trend-health signal would break.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite eligibility, low durability (0.47) and extremely narrow breadth (0.11) point to fragile leadership. Underweight is a caution against relying on the momentum focus for this theme given weak trend health, even though the gate is satisfied.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed, no clear trending direction
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate is still met, which historically mitigates drawdown; a sudden copper supply disruption could reignite momentum and trend health rapidly.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar rises above 0.6 and breadth expands above 0.5, the fragility case would be invalidated.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
